recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16421; future Patient $everything wording changes should be made in the Admin Incubator source if that external definition changes.
issue_request: FHIR-16421 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Administration technical correction for the Patient $everything page. It asked to correct "Absense" to "Absence" and, in duplicated reporter comments, "mimimum" to "minimum".
initial_application: Historical commit 9e75eb3795fde681b5809e83f51f02ebbebd2131, "GF#16421: typo GF#16039: Update reference from DAF to US Core", changed the Patient $everything source sentence from "at a mimimum" to "at a minimum". Source-history checks did not find a retained literal "Absense" spelling in Patient source; the relevant historical source already used "absence" where that concept appeared.
additional_context: Patient remains an active core resource, but the current Patient operations list includes only Patient-match and Patient-purge. Later commit b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc removed the Patient $everything OperationDefinition from core, and current core pages link to the Admin Incubator definition, whose narrative says "At a minimum" and contains no "Absense" spelling.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested Patient typo correction is already satisfied by historical source changes and by the current absence of a core-owned Patient $everything OperationDefinition.

related_jiras.note: The same historical commit paired FHIR-16421 with the related DAF-to-US Core wording update on Patient $everything.
Separate Published PA issue on the same Patient $everything sentence; its audit on the combined branch confirms the same historical application and later move out of core.
